GPU-Based Volume Rendering for Medical Imagery
Abstract—We present a method for fast volume rendering using graphics hardware (GPU). To our knowledge, it is the first imple-mentation on the GPU. Based on the Shear-Warp algorithm, our GPU-based method provides real-time frame rates and outperforms the CPU-based implementation.
